synopsis: Chapter 2 reports that Honda investigation EA25-002 added 295,125 Insight and Passport vehicles in January 2025 [f1488]. Chapter 13 identifies this as an NHTSA engineering analysis investigating false automatic braking, while the glossary describes it as further Honda CMBS analysis [f10423, f15763]. The vehicle count covers Insight and Passport together; these facts provide neither an Insight-only count nor an investigation outcome [f1488, f10423, f15763].
